about: Rung 1 of the ladder. Each entry is one source kept byte for byte as found, with where it came from. The ladder loader (libraries/ladder_load.py) breaks each one into registry pieces, rebuilds it from those pieces alone, and loads it into Neon only if the rebuild is byte-exact.
